function GetPlayer(name)
    for i,v in pairs(game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayers()) do
        if v.DisplayName:lower():sub(1, #name) == name:lower() or v.Name:lower():sub(1, #name) == name:lower() then
            return v
        end
    end    
end
